Russian

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • во́стрый (vóstryj) — regional

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Proto-Slavic *ostrъ, from Proto-Indo-European *h₂eḱrós.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈostrɨj]
  • Audio:(file)

Adjective

[edit]

о́стрый • (óstryj) (comparative (по)остре́е or (по)остре́й)

  1. sharp, pointed
  2. acute
  3. keen
  4. critical
  5. (of food) hot, spicy
